description: List a firm's appointed representatives (principal/AR relationships) by Firm Reference Number (FRN). Returns an empty list for a firm with no appointed representatives -- that is a real answer, not a failure. Example: fca_firm_representatives({ frn: "122702" })

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own FCA Register API credentials as "<email>:<key>" (the email you registered with, a colon, then the issued key). Omit it to use the Pipeworx key. Register free at https://register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/registernewuser.

name: fca_firm_representatives
title: Fca Firm Representatives
